periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the black eye patches is oriented vertically with a slight inward tilt of the upper poles toward the nasal bridge.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a visual height approximately 1.8 times the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patch displays a distinct downward elongation, with the lowest point extending significantly below the horizontal axis of the eye.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Ears are widely separated, positioned at the extreme lateral-superior margins of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semicircular curvature at the apex of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Open oral cavity exposing the tongue and lower dentition during the mastication of bamboo stalks.
